title: Fiat Chrysler Automobiles
description: Fiat Chrysler Automobiles uses a broad automotive palette: red (#ff1430), teal blue (#01557a), light aqua (#91d1db), indigo (#3b369e), deep navy (#212652), near-black (#18131f), warm off-white (#edede3), pink (#ff8094), amber (#ffb80f), and burgundy (#a31445).
